newsitem.title: CHINA: China firm succeeds in microwave oven price war.
newsitem.headline: China firm succeeds in microwave oven price war.

text.p: A young firm that launched a price war in China's crowded microwave oven market claimed spectacular results in building market share for one of the country's fast-growing consumer products.
Galanz, which started producing microwave ovens only in 1993, cut the prices of its two top models on August 3 by 40 percent in Beijing and Shanghai, its two major markets.
